tjs.description: Adding TJS language support for Visual Studio Code
tjs.untrustedWorkspaces.description: Syntax highlighting, colors, snippets, and reference search remain available. Running ctags is disabled because it starts an external process using workspace settings.
tjs.virtualWorkspaces.description: Syntax highlighting, colors, snippets, and reference search remain available. Running ctags is disabled because virtual workspace files are not available to external processes.
tjs.updateCtags.title: Update Ctags Index File
tjs.openReferencePallet.title: Open reference search pallet
tjs.configuration.title: TJS Configuration
tjs.items.tagFilePath.description: Path to the Ctags' index file
tjs.items.searchPath.description: Path to the directory where ctags search tjs files
tjs.items.runOnSave.description: Whether recreate the index file automatically when tjs file is saved
tjs.items.fileExtensions.description: File extensions to be searched as tjs file
tjs.items.extraOption.description: Command-line options which will be passed to ctags
tjs.items.extraOption.deprecationMessage: Deprecated. Use `extraArgs`, with one ctags option per array item. `extraOption` will be removed.
tjs.items.extraArgs.description: Additional arguments passed directly to Ctags. Each array item is passed as one argument without shell parsing.
tjs.items.timeoutMs.description: Maximum ctags execution time in milliseconds. Set to 0 to disable the timeout.
tjs.ctagsRunOnSaveLanguages.description: Languages to run ctags process whose runOnSave is true when these languages' file is saved
tjs.referencePalletEnable.description: Whether to show in the reference search pallet
